ai_recommendations.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `ai_recommendations` (
  `id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `farmer_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `category` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'Advisory',
  `priority` varchar(20) DEFAULT 'HIGH',
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  `action_type` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_completed` tinyint(1) DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_rec_farmer` (`farmer_id`)

bank_applications.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `bank_applications` (
  `id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `farmer_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `farmer_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `crop_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `loan_type` varchar(100) DEFAULT 'Kisan Credit Card (KCC)',
  `amount` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT '0.00',

bank_users.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `bank_users` (
  `id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `bank_id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `password_hash` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('admin','staff') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'staff',
  `status` enum('active','inactive','suspended') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`),
  KEY `fk_bankusers_bank` (`bank_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_bankusers_bank` FOREIGN KEY (`bank_id`) REFERENCES `banks` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

banks.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `banks` (
  `id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `bank_name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `institution_type` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `official_website` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `official_email` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `official_phone` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `logo_url` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `registered_address` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `state` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `district` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `verification_status` enum('draft','submitted','under_review','verified','rejected','suspended') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `official_email` (`official_email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

bookings.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `bookings` (
  `id` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `farmer_id` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `equipment_id` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `start_date` date NOT NULL,
  `end_date` date NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_bookings_farmer` (`farmer_id`),
  KEY `idx_bookings_equipment` (`equipment_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_bookings_equipment` FOREIGN KEY (`equipment_id`) REFERENCES `equipment` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_bookings_farmer` FOREIGN KEY (`farmer_id`) REFERENCES `farmers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

crop_risk.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `crop_risk` (
  `id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `farmer_id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `crop_id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `risk_score` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `risk_level` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `weather_score` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `soil_score` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `crop_health_score` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `market_score` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `financial_score` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `calculated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  KEY `idx_crop_risk_farmer` (`farmer_id`),
  KEY `idx_crop_risk_crop` (`crop_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_crop_risk_crop` FOREIGN KEY (`crop_id`) REFERENCES `crops` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_crop_risk_farmer` FOREIGN KEY (`farmer_id`) REFERENCES `farmers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

crops.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `crops` (
  `id` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `farmer_id` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `stage` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `sowing_date` date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_crops_farmer` (`farmer_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_crops_farmer` FOREIGN KEY (`farmer_id`) REFERENCES `farmers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

disaster_warnings.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `disaster_warnings` (

equipment.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `equipment` (
  `id` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `type` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `owner` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,

equipment_rentals.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `equipment_rentals` (
  `id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,

  `start_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `end_time` datetime NOT NULL,

  CONSTRAINT `fk_equipment_rentals_farmer` FOREIGN KEY (`farmer_id`) REFERENCES `farmers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

facility_analytics.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `facility_analytics` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `facility_id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `event_type` enum('VIEW','TERMS_VIEW','APPLY_CLICK') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `farmer_location` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),

  CONSTRAINT `fk_analytics_facility` FOREIGN KEY (`facility_id`) REFERENCES `financial_facilities` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=18 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

facility_benefits.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `facility_benefits` (
  `id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,

  KEY `fk_benefits_facility` (`facility_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_benefits_facility` FOREIGN KEY (`facility_id`) REFERENCES `financial_facilities` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

facility_documents.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `facility_documents` (
  `id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `facility_id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `document_name` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `is_required` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_documents_facility` (`facility_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_documents_facility` FOREIGN KEY (`facility_id`) REFERENCES `financial_facilities` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE

facility_eligibility.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `facility_eligibility` (
  `id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `facility_id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `farmer_type` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `minimum_land` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `maximum_land` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,

  CONSTRAINT `fk_eligibility_facility` FOREIGN KEY (`facility_id`) REFERENCES `financial_facilities` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE

facility_terms.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `facility_terms` (
  `id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `facility_id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `version` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '1.0',
  `terms_text` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

farmer_profiles.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `farmer_profiles` (

farmers.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `farmers` (
  `id` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(150) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(15) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `password_hash` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `district` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `village` varchar(50) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `language` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,

  `loan_amount` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT NULL,

farms.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `farms` (
  `id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,

  `latitude` decimal(10,7) NOT NULL,
  `longitude` decimal(10,7) NOT NULL,
  `area` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `soil_type` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `village` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `district` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

financial_facilities.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `financial_facilities` (
  `id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `bank_id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `facility_name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `facility_type` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `minimum_amount` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `maximum_amount` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `interest_rate` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `tenure` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `repayment_frequency` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `processing_fee` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `eligibility_description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `status` enum('draft','submitted','under_review','approved','published','unpublished','expired','suspended','deleted') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `application_url` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `terms_url` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `expiry_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_facilities_bank` (`bank_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_facilities_bank` FOREIGN KEY (`bank_id`) REFERENCES `banks` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

government_schemes.createStatement:

insurance.createStatement:

  `crop` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,

interventions.createStatement:

loans.createStatement:

notifications.createStatement:
CREATE TABLE `notifications` (
  `id` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `user_id` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `farmer_id` varchar(30) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `type` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `category` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `priority` enum('critical','warning','info') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(200) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `message` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `body` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `voice_text` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `language` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT 'en',
  `action_label` varchar(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `action_url` varchar(300) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `action_status` enum('not_required','required','in_progress','completed','expired') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT 'not_required',
  `source_feature` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_entity_id` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `correlation_id` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_read` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `read_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `channel` enum('SMS','IN_APP','VOICE','PUSH') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IN_APP',
  `status` enum('PENDING','SENT','DELIVERED','FAILED') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
